items.a: University students, graduates, lecturers, and employees in government, banking or enterprise. Some tracks have a technical prerequisite, which we check in the entry test.

items.q: Is teaching in Arabic or English?
items.a: Both. Explanation and support are in Arabic; technical terms, tools and exams are in English, because that is how the certifications are set.

items.q: Are the exams really sat here?
items.a: That is the plan for the certifications listed on each track: a Pearson VUE and EC-Council room on site. Until accreditation is finalised we book you into a partner centre at no extra cost.

items.q: What is the price, and can I pay in instalments?
items.a: Each track shows its price in QAR. Instalments are available for the longer tracks; ask us on WhatsApp and we will set them out for you.
Yes — in a netted cage on site, and in permitted areas under QCAA permits. Everything is civilian and educational.

items.q: Do you train companies and government entities?
items.a: Yes. Closed cohorts, at our site or yours, with framework contracts and reporting for Qatarisation programmes.
An academy certificate for the track, plus the international certification you pass — vendor certificates from the manufacturers, or CEH, Security+, CCNA, HCIA and similar.
In Doha. The exact address and directions are on the contact page, and we will send you a map pin on WhatsApp.

about.title: About the academy
about.subtitle: A practice-first technology academy in Doha.
about.story: Qatar does not lack talented people or ambitious programmes. What it lacks is a place where somebody can put their hands on an industrial robot, a real network rack or a live cyber range, and be taught by the people who build those things for a living. Qatar Tech Education was founded to be that place — and to make the international certificate that follows a matter of walking into the next room, not flying abroad.
about.method: Every module starts with something to build and ends with something that works. Theory is delivered in short briefings at the bench, never as a lecture series. Learners are assessed on what they produced, and every track finishes with an international certification exam.
about.cascade: Manufacturers and certified freelance experts train a founding team of 20 to 30 selected graduates and lecturers for three months. That team becomes our permanent staff and trains the cohorts that follow — so the expertise stays in Qatar instead of leaving with a visiting consultant.
